CoC re-audit, short (32 cards)

CSV: sample_id, decision, causes, peeking, note (OK / wrong / unsure). Kept in this browser.

How to audit
Decision: does the label match the speed chart and path?
Causes: is each named thing really there at t0 and relevant?
No peeking: does any cause rely on something seen only in future frames?
32 cards. (a) 13 decision changes and (b) 8 non-mechanical text changes from your v2 audit, v2 text in grey beside v3; (c) 7 traces for the new turn / nudge rules; (d) 5 fresh traces. v3: no route command in the causes; agent distances from the front bumper; only agents inside the ego path corridor; turns also when the heading changes > 45 deg in 6 s; in-lane nudge.
